package com.dpscalc.wikisetups.bank;

/**
 * Which item a slot should hold.
 *
 * BEST_OWNED walks the wiki's ranked alternatives and takes the best one the
 * player can actually field — the plugin's normal, adaptive behaviour.
 *
 * TOP_RECOMMENDATION takes the wiki's own first choice regardless of
 * ownership, still flagging whether the player owns it, so the preview and
 * import can show the literal recommendation (a BIS / shopping-list view).
 * Reasoning that is *derived from ownership* — set-bonus gating and the
 * inventory's substitution chain — is suspended under this strategy;
 * everything else (slayer-task gating, two-handed shield handling,
 * variation and upgrade acceptance) applies to both.
 */
public enum PickStrategy
{
	BEST_OWNED,
	TOP_RECOMMENDATION
}

package com.dpscalc.wikisetups.items;

import java.util.List;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

/**
 * Bidirectional item name/id lookup. Backed by a scan of client item
 * definitions at runtime; faked in tests.
 */
public interface ItemNameIndex
{
	/** Item ids whose in-game name matches (after {@link ItemNames#normalize}). Empty if none or not ready. */
	List<Integer> idsByName(String normalizedName);

	@Nullable
	String nameById(int itemId);

	boolean isReady();
}

package com.dpscalc.wikisetups.items;

import java.util.Locale;

/** Name normalization shared by the index and the resolver. */
public final class ItemNames
{
	private ItemNames()
	{
	}

	/**
	 * Lowercase, straight apostrophes, collapsed whitespace, and no space
	 * before parentheses — the game is inconsistent ("Salve amulet(i)" but
	 * "Ring of suffering (i)") and the wiki always writes the space.
	 *
	 * Underscores become spaces: links are sometimes written in URL form
	 * ("{{plink|Blessed_bracers}}"), and no item name contains one.
	 */
	public static String normalize(String name)
	{
		return name
			.replace('’', '\'')
			.replace('_', ' ')
			.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
			.replaceAll("\\s+\\(", "(")
			.replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
			.trim();
	}

	/**
	 * Removes charge/degradation decorations so variants compare equal to
	 * their base: parenthesized numbers "(10)" and a trailing bare number
	 * ("Karil's leathertop 100"). Non-numeric parens like "(i)" are kept —
	 * they distinguish genuinely different items.
	 */
	public static String stripChargeDecorations(String normalizedName)
	{
		return normalizedName
			.replaceAll("\\(\\d+\\)", "")
			.replaceAll("\\s+\\d+$", "")
			.replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
			.trim();
	}
}

package com.dpscalc.wikisetups.items;

import java.util.Set;

/**
 * A wiki item name resolved to game item ids. primaryId is the exact-name
 * match used for display; acceptableIds is every variant that satisfies the
 * recommendation (charges, degradation states, recolors, upgrades).
 */
public class ResolvedItem
{
	private final String wikiName;
	private final int primaryId;
	private final Set<Integer> acceptableIds;

	public ResolvedItem(String wikiName, int primaryId, Set<Integer> acceptableIds) { this.wikiName = wikiName; this.primaryId = primaryId; this.acceptableIds = acceptableIds; }
	public String getWikiName() { return wikiName; }
	public int getPrimaryId() { return primaryId; }
	public Set<Integer> getAcceptableIds() { return acceptableIds; }
}

package com.dpscalc.wikisetups.wiki;


public class SearchResult
{
	private final String title;
	private final int pageId;

	public SearchResult(String title, int pageId) { this.title = title; this.pageId = pageId; }
	public String getTitle() { return title; }
	public int getPageId() { return pageId; }
}
